## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 33. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke frames the vacancy as expected but early: Missouri State had to be quietly planning for Ryan Beard to be offered another job, but they probably didn't think it would be so soon. With Beard off to Coastal Carolina following the programme's first FBS season, AD Patrick Ransdell — who got the job just before the start of the football season — moved quickly to hire Woods from SMU. Burke lists the breadth of the résumé: Woods has worn a lot of different hats, including OC under Rhett Lashlee and director of player personnel at Auburn. He then vouches for the process rather than only the man — Ransdell understands mid-major football, having worked at App State and UCF previously, so Burke thinks he's trustworthy in isolating Woods as quickly as he did. His conclusion rests on lineage: a man who has worked under Gus Malzahn, Bill Clark, Eli Drinkwitz and Lashlee, and is also the son of 50-year coaching vet Sparky Woods, probably ends up being a solid hire.
